selection_reason: Module interface spec (S004) provides port context for first declaration block
Register specification (S005) lists all required register definitions
Submodule description (S006) and its IO port specification (S007) provide exact port mappings for instantiation
Interface specification (S004) provides Wishbone master output port definitions for address and control signal generation
Operation specifications detail control sequence: initialization (S009), data transfer (S010), disabled state (S011), including flag usage and register updates
FIFO port specification (S007) provides the internal signals to be forwarded
